question: Which two leaders of the people did Ezekiel see among the twenty-five men at the east gate?
options: Jaazaniah son of Azzur and Pelatiah son of Benaiah
Jaazaniah son of Shaphan and Gedaliah son of Ahikam
Hananiah son of Azzur and Pashhur son of Immer
Zedekiah son of Josiah and Seraiah son of Neriah
explanation: At the east gate were twenty-five men, among them Jaazaniah son of Azzur and Pelatiah son of Benaiah, leaders of the people.
